title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING A PROVINCIAL FISCAL FOR THE PROVINCE OF MASBATE AND REPEALING SECTION SIX OF ACT ONE HUNDRED AND FIVE.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING A PROVINCIAL FISCAL FOR THE PROVINCE OF MASBATE AND REPEALING SECTION SIX OF ACT ONE HUNDRED AND FIVE.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00221_1901_html.txt

text.en:
There shall be in the Province of Masbate a provincial fiscal, whose salary shall be eight hundred
dollars a year, in money of the United States.

Section six of Act Numbered One hundred and five, making applicable the general provincial Act
to the Province of Masbate, is hereby repealed.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 5, 1901.
